# ODVIS — Law Firm Vešligaj and Sliepčević

> Croatian law firm in Zagreb, founded on 3 May 2016. Public procurement (including DKOM proceedings), real estate and land registry, labour law and general legal services. The site is bilingual: English at `/`, Croatian at `/hr/`.

## Pages

- [Home (EN)](https://odvis.hr/): services, about the firm, DKOM practice, contact
- [Početna (HR)](https://odvis.hr/hr/)
- [Public Procurement](https://odvis.hr/expertise/public-procurement/): includes selected winning DKOM cases with the decisions as PDF files under `/docs/`
- [Real Estate and Land Registry Law](https://odvis.hr/expertise/real-estate/)
- [Labour Law & Employment Contracts](https://odvis.hr/expertise/labour-law/)
- [General Legal Support](https://odvis.hr/expertise/general-legal/)
- [Team](https://odvis.hr/team/)
- [Privacy Policy](https://odvis.hr/privacy/)
- [Legal Notice](https://odvis.hr/legal-notice/)

Full list with Croatian equivalents: https://odvis.hr/sitemap.xml
